summary: Iteration 16 — Meeting rooms + booking approval flow. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass (auto-seed idempotency, RBAC on rooms CRUD, duplicate name, feature filtering, soft-delete + include_inactive, conflict-check, 30-min auto-approved, 409 conflict message, >120min & recurring approval flow, super_admin/HR auto-approve, approve/reject with note, 400 on second decide, inactive+invalid room 400). Frontend: HR meetings page shows 2 tabs with pending badge, dialog with room dropdown + feature badges + available hint + conflict banner wiring, recurring toggle reveals approval banner and switches submit label to 'Submit for approval'. Approvals queue renders pending row → decision dialog → Approve & notify → toast + row disappears. Settings Meeting-rooms panel shows 2 seeded rooms with add/edit/delete/show-deactivated controls. Employee at /employee/meetings has no approvals tab. Manager at /admin/meetings has no approvals tab (correct RBAC).

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — add DialogDescription for a11y compliance (non-blocking)
Console error: 'Received NaN for the %s attribute' seen on employee dashboard — unrelated to this feature but should be investigated separately

action_items: (nit) Add DialogDescription to NewMeetingDialog, ApprovalsQueue decision dialog, and RoomDialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
(unrelated pre-existing) Investigate 'Received NaN for the %s attribute' React warning on employee /employee (Today) page — not caused by this iteration but visible during Maya login.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rooms.py ensure_default_rooms is idempotent but is called on every GET /api/rooms — cheap count query, acceptable.
routes/meetings.py — _has_conflict correctly excludes cancelled + rejected; approve re-checks conflict (returns 409). Good.
routes/meetings.py — pending meetings do NOT send WhatsApp/email invites; invites fire only on approve/auto_approve — matches spec.
Meetings.jsx (536 lines) is close to the 700-line splitting threshold; NewMeetingDialog + ApprovalsQueue could be extracted into separate files for maintainability (not blocking).

MeetingRoomsPanel.jsx — soft-deleted rooms are shown only when 'Show deactivated' toggled; edit/delete buttons hidden for inactive rooms → cannot reactivate from UI. Consider a 'Reactivate' button or exposing the active toggle in the edit dialog (backend PATCH supports active:true).
MeetingRoomsPanel: RoomDialog reuses same DialogContent inside two Dialog wrappers — pattern is fine; state uses room object identity which works.
Backend supports 'biweekly' recurrence frequency in UI select but backend model just stores dict as-is → OK (no enum enforcement).
test_credentials: Used credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin@acme.com, jordan@acme.com (HR), alex@acme.com (manager), maya@acme.com (employee).
seed_data_creation: Test suite created ~17 TEST_-prefixed meetings + a couple of TEST_-prefixed rooms; all cleaned up via cleanup script after run. TEST_inact_* rooms remain soft-deleted (visible only with include_inactive=true) — safe.
